description: QuickTime Player has been launched with the audio file ~/Documents/qtp_target_audio.aiff (a ~2.16-second copy of the macOS system sound `Funk.aiff`) already loaded and paused at 0:00. Press the space bar to start playback and let the clip play through past the 1.0-second mark. The verifier reads QuickTime's scripting interface (no AX required) to confirm: (1) the front document is qtp_target_audio.aiff, (2) playback advanced past 1.0 seconds, (3) the file was not replaced or relocated. Do not open any other file.

_audit.comment: Ground-truth provenance fields kept outside the agent-visible `metadata` root. Future agent harnesses that expose task_info.metadata won't surface these. The verifier explicitly `del`s task_info before scoring, so this is defense-in-depth — but having a separate top-level key documents the boundary explicitly.
_audit.source_attribution: macOS system sound asset shipped by Apple under /System/Library/Sounds/ — used in-place under fair-use for evaluation.
